scope: 2018-01-01..2023-12-31, same two manifest files, no holdout
primary_objective: maximum cumulative gross qfq fractional-share return over entire authorized observed interval; no drawdown/risk/annual/time-split constraints
ties: lower daily-close max drawdown, then lexicographic parameter tuple

stage1.entry_formula: MAfast>MAslow*(1+entry_buffer) OR (close>previous breakout closes maximum AND close>MAslow)

filters.recovery: close>MAslow AND MAslow>=MAslow.shift(5) AND close>previous5-close maximum AND maximum drawdown-from-trailing60-close-peak in previous20 bars>=0.04

stage1.negative_buffers: explicitly permit -1% offsets to explore prior zero-buffer boundary; formula unchanged.
stage1.seeding: Take highest-return8 distinct fixed-rule parameter tuples from stage1 only; tie lower drawdown then lexicographic tuple. No diversity or risk criteria override.

stage2.generation: Add each Cartesian offset tuple, clip to bounds, retain fast<slow, deduplicate all stage2 candidates; seed configuration included.

adaptive_benchmark: Retain prior adaptive return champion as a fixed comparison only; no risk constraints used.
execution: same next tradable bar open after signal close; exit signal i earliest reentry check close i+cool; all-in/cash; peak from entry-signal close; no fabricated final liquidation; daily-close mark. Exclude tradestatus0 before windows and fills.
warmup: none/price_slow max(fast,slow,breakout+1); slope5 additionally slow+5; recovery additionally80 bars; no earlier data.

cost_sensitivity.method: Proportional fraction of portfolio NAV deducted at every ideal buy and sell fill; same price signals and fills, still fractional; no terminal sale assumed. Report only, never select by costs.
cost_sensitivity.not_actual_account: No integer-lot, corporate-action cash/share, liquidity or official fee reconstruction.

reporting: annualized gross return using elapsed calendar days
closed/open trades, closed-trade winrate and fill counts
training-only annual/trade attribution versus old winner
limit: exactly two predeclared stages, no extra search after results
